name: ci

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  RUSTFLAGS: -D warnings

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: rustfmt, clippy
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - run: cargo fmt --all -- --check
      - run: cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features

  test:
    needs: lint
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-24.04, macos-14, windows-2022]
        toolchain: [stable, "1.78"]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ matrix.toolchain }}
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          key: ${{ matrix.toolchain }}
      - name: Build
        run: cargo build --locked --all-features
      - name: Test
        run: cargo test --locked --all-features -- --nocapture
      - name: Doc tests
        if: matrix.toolchain == 'stable'
        run: cargo test --doc --locked

  release-build:
    if: github.event_name == 'push'
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          targets: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
      - run: sudo apt-get install -y musl-tools
      - run: cargo build --release --locked --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4

import json, sys
from collections import Counter

plan = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
changes = plan.get("resource_changes", [])
counter = Counter()
dangerous = []
for rc in changes:
    actions = tuple(rc["change"]["actions"])
    if actions == ("no-op",):
        continue
    key = "replace" if set(actions) == {"delete", "create"} else "+".join(actions)
    counter[key] += 1
    if "delete" in actions:
        dangerous.append((key, rc["address"]))

print("Plan summary (dev):")
for action in ("create", "update", "replace", "delete"):
    print(f"  {action:<8} {counter.get(action, 0):>4}")

if dangerous:
    print("\nResources that would be deleted or replaced:")
    for key, address in sorted(dangerous):
        print(f"  [{key}] {address}")

drift = plan.get("resource_drift", [])
if drift:
    print(f"\nDrift detected on {len(drift)} resources:")
    for d in drift[:15]:
        print("  ~", d["address"])

outputs = plan.get("planned_values", {}).get("outputs", {})
sensitive = [k for k, v in outputs.items() if v.get("sensitive")]
print(f"\nOutputs: {len(outputs)} ({len(sensitive)} sensitive, values not shown)")
sys.exit(2 if counter.get("delete") or counter.get("replace") else 0)
PY
status=$?

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Developer bootstrap for ripdiff: checks toolchain, fixtures and benchmarks.
set -euo pipefail

need() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; }

echo "[1/6] rust toolchain"
rustc --version
cargo --version
rustup component list --installed | grep -E 'clippy|rustfmt' || echo 'missing clippy/rustfmt'

echo "[2/6] system tools used by the test fixtures"
missing=()
for tool in jq hyperfine git-lfs; do
  need "$tool" || missing+=("$tool")
done
if [ ${#missing[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
  echo "installing: ${missing[*]}"
  sudo apt-get install -y "${missing[@]}"
fi
jq --version

echo "[3/6] fixtures"
git lfs pull --include 'tests/fixtures/**'
du -sh tests/fixtures

echo "[4/6] build"
cargo build --release --locked

echo "[5/6] quick tests"
cargo test --locked -q -- --test-threads=4

echo "[6/6] benchmark against GNU diff"
hyperfine --warmup 2 --export-markdown target/bench.md \
  'target/release/ripdiff tests/fixtures/big_a.txt tests/fixtures/big_b.txt' \
  'diff tests/fixtures/big_a.txt tests/fixtures/big_b.txt'
sed -n '1,12p' target/bench.md

#!/bin/sh
# Make the local Postgres used by the tests listen on the docker bridge.
set -eu
PGVER=16
CONF=/etc/postgresql/$PGVER/main
BRIDGE=$(ip -4 -o addr show docker0 | awk '{print $4}' | cut -d/ -f1)
echo "docker bridge address: $BRIDGE"

echo "--- current settings"
grep -nE "^\s*(listen_addresses|port|max_connections)" $CONF/postgresql.conf || true
grep -vE '^\s*(#|$)' $CONF/pg_hba.conf

if grep -q "172.17.0.0/16" $CONF/pg_hba.conf; then
  echo "pg_hba already allows the bridge"
else
  echo "--- adding one pg_hba line for the docker bridge (md5, test database only)"
  printf 'host    invoice_test    invoice    172.17.0.0/16    scram-sha-256\n' \
    | sudo tee -a $CONF/pg_hba.conf >/dev/null
fi

sudo -u postgres psql -Atc "ALTER SYSTEM SET listen_addresses = 'localhost,$BRIDGE';"
sudo systemctl restart postgresql@$PGVER-main
sleep 2
pg_isready -h "$BRIDGE" -p 5432
sudo -u postgres psql -Atc 'SHOW listen_addresses;'
sudo -u postgres psql -Atc "SELECT type, database, user_name, address, auth_method FROM pg_hba_file_rules WHERE address IS NOT NULL;"
docker run --rm --network bridge postgres:16-alpine pg_isready -h "$BRIDGE" -p 5432

set -euo pipefail
site=shopfront
src="deploy/nginx/${site}.conf"
dest="/etc/nginx/sites-available/${site}.conf"

echo "-- checking that the rendered config differs from the installed one"
if diff -u "$dest" "$src" > /tmp/${site}-nginx.diff; then
  echo "no change, nothing to do"; exit 0
fi
sed -n '1,60p' /tmp/${site}-nginx.diff

echo "-- static checks on the new file"
grep -nE 'server_name|listen|root|proxy_pass' "$src"
if grep -qE 'autoindex\s+on' "$src"; then
  echo "refusing: autoindex on" >&2; exit 1
fi

echo "-- installing"
sudo install -m 0644 -o root -g root "$src" "$dest"
sudo ln -sfn "$dest" "/etc/nginx/sites-enabled/${site}.conf"

echo "-- validating the full configuration"
if ! sudo nginx -t 2>&1 | tee /tmp/${site}-nginx-t.log; then
  echo "nginx -t failed, restoring previous file" >&2
  sudo cp "/tmp/${site}-nginx.diff" /dev/null
  git show HEAD:"$src" | sudo tee "$dest" >/dev/null
  exit 1
fi

echo "-- restarting nginx"
sudo systemctl restart nginx
sleep 1
systemctl is-active nginx
curl -fsS -o /dev/null -w 'local health: %{http_code} in %{time_total}s\n' \
  -H "Host: ${site}.local" http://127.0.0.1/healthz

---
- name: Install and configure nginx on web hosts
  hosts: web
  become: true
  vars:
    nginx_worker_connections: 2048
    site_name: shopfront
    site_root: /srv/www/shopfront
  handlers:
    - name: Reload nginx
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: nginx
        state: reloaded
  tasks:
    - name: Install nginx and certbot
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name:
          - nginx
          - python3-certbot-nginx
        state: present
        update_cache: true
        cache_valid_time: 3600

    - name: Create site root
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ site_root }}"
        state: directory
        owner: www-data
        group: www-data
        mode: "0755"

    - name: Deploy main nginx configuration
      ansible.builtin.template:
        src: templates/nginx.conf.j2
        dest: /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
        mode: "0644"
        validate: nginx -t -c %s
      notify: Reload nginx

    - name: Deploy site configuration
      ansible.builtin.template:
        src: templates/site.conf.j2
        dest: "/etc/nginx/sites-available/{{ site_name }}.conf"
        mode: "0644"
      notify: Reload nginx

    - name: Enable site
      ansible.builtin.file:
        src: "/etc/nginx/sites-available/{{ site_name }}.conf"
        dest: "/etc/nginx/sites-enabled/{{ site_name }}.conf"
        state: link
      notify: Reload nginx

    - name: Remove default site
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/default
        state: absent
      notify: Reload nginx

    - name: Ensure nginx is enabled and running
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: nginx
        state: started
        enabled: true
